chunks: With this chain of transmission, from al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Hammad, from Hariz, from Zurarah, from Abi Ja'far عليه السلام, who said:
The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم used to perform wudu (ablution) with one mudd and perform ghusl (ritual bath) with one sa'. A mudd is one and a half ratls, and a sa' is six ratls.

key_terms.بِصَاعٍ: with one sa', a larger standard measure
key_terms.بِمُدٍّ: with one mudd, a standard liquid measure
key_terms.رِطْلٌ: a ratl, a unit of weight or volume measure

ai.seo_question: How much water is sufficient for wudu (ablution) and ghusl according to the hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith reports the practice of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم regarding the amount of water used for wudu (ablution) and ghusl (ritual bath). It also defines the measures of mudd and sa', making it relevant for rulings on ritual purity and the sufficiency of water in worship.
